public.weekly_source_kept_as_paid_decisi.ddl:
create table public.weekly_source_kept_as_paid_decisions (
  id uuid primary key default pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid(),
  work_event_id uuid not null references public.weekly_work_events(id) on delete restrict,
  decision text not null check (decision='KEEP_AS_PAID'),
  reason text not null check (reason in ('CREDITED','NOT_INVOICED_DISAPPEARED')),
  credit_invoice_line_id uuid references public.invoice_lines(id) on delete restrict,
  facts_fingerprint bytea not null check (pg_catalog.octet_length(facts_fingerprint)=32),
  actor_user_id uuid not null references public.tms_users(id) on delete restrict,
  created_at_utc timestamptz not null default pg_catalog.transaction_timestamp(),
  check ((reason='CREDITED')=(credit_invoice_line_id is not null))
);
